# `torchsky.map.operators.noise`

!!! warning "Experimental surface"
    These APIs are under active development. Names, defaults, and result
    objects may change between minor releases; pin a version if you depend
    on them in production.

Per-pixel detector likelihoods: the normalized Gaussian negative log-likelihood, and the Poisson-Gaussian mixture for a few electrons per pixel read out with Gaussian noise. Both are also importable from `torchsky.map.operators`.

**Guides:** [likelihoods](../models/likelihoods.md)
